description: This file defines the ServiceMcaUtil class, which manages and evaluates Service MCA (Mail Content Adapter) rules for email services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods for loading configuration, caching rules, and evaluating rules against email messages.

classes.name: ServiceMcaUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing and evaluating Service MCA rules, including loading, caching, and rule evaluation.

methods.name: reloadConfig
methods.description: Clears the MCA cache and reloads the MCA configuration from component resources.

methods.name: readConfig
methods.description: Loads MCA configuration from all service resource info with type 'mca'.

methods.name: addMcaDefinitions
methods.description: Parses a ResourceHandler's XML to load MCA rules into cache.

methods.name: getServiceMcaRules
methods.description: Returns all cached ServiceMcaRule objects, reloading config if cache is empty.

methods.name: evalRules
methods.description: Evaluates all MCA rules against a given email message within a specific dispatch context and user.
